classes.name: manifest
classes.reason: Each round every rank hits barrier.wait(), then all synchronously _read_staged the same per-round manifest and barrier again, so one file's read holds the whole job; the path manifest(workdir, r, ...) is a distinct file per round, so a given rank reads a given manifest once.

classes.name: sidecar
classes.reason: After the post-manifest barrier each rank loops _read(sidecar(workdir, me, i, ...)) on its own rank-private files with no intervening barrier, so only the reading rank waits, and the same sidecar index is re-read in each of the 200 rounds.

classes.name: shard
classes.reason: Each rank synchronously _read()s its own shard files (shard(workdir, me, i)) in the unsynchronised tail of every round, blocking only itself, and the same shard is read once per round for 200 rounds.
